newsitem.title: INDIA: 21 die in India tractor-truck collision.
newsitem.headline: 21 die in India tractor-truck collision.

text.p: At least 21 people were killed and 24 injured in northern India on Tuesday when a tractor-trolley in which they were travelling collided with a truck, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The news agency said the accident occured near Faizabad, some 130 km (80 mile) east of Lucknow, the capital of Uttar Pradesh state.

The victims were travelling to the Saryu River, which flows past Faizabad's twin town of Ayodhya. Many Hindus believe that Ayodhya is the birthplace of the god-king Rama and that bathing in the Saryu River is spiritually purifying.
PTI said 17 people perished on the spot and four died of their injuries on the way to a nearby hospital.
Trolleys attached to tractors are often used as a means of transport in rural India, where public road transport services are inadequate or considered expensive.
